decision.reason: YourStory original profile describes TRL5 methane plasma pyrolysis producing both hydrogen and carbon black; measurable pilot economics.

opportunities.core_job: Reconcile methane input and energy with hydrogen and carbon black output during pilot-scale commercialization
opportunities.target_customer: Methane pyrolysis developers, refinery energy transition teams and H2 project financiers
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-supplied methane feed, energy, H2 and solid carbon output, carbon-grade price, trial conditions and cost entries; material-balance and TCO/uncertainty comparison
opportunities.why_now: YourStory 13 October reports Hypersonic Technologies TRL5 staged-plasma pilot producing hydrogen and carbon black; commercialization depends on proving dual-product yield economics.
opportunities.before_state: Hydrogen/coproduct economics and test evidence tracked on separate, unversioned spreadsheets.
opportunities.after_state: A versioned transparent yields, coproduct revenue and trial-cost case approved by engineer.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Manual datasets and browser-only deterministic calculations; competition and cost claims not final
